card.name: Dose amounts just before a number
card.fires_on: Words and units inside dosing instructions right before the next number or schedule, such as 'divided' in 'equally divided doses', 'mg' before 'at Weeks', or 'every' before an interval.

modes.label: Units and amounts
modes.description: A unit or digit piece in a dose that is followed by another amount or time.

modes.label: Schedule wording
modes.description: Words like divided or every that lead into a dosing interval.
modes.example: 75 to 100 mg/kg in equally<< divided>> doses every 6 hours

card.writes: The promoted and suppressed tokens are mostly unrelated multilingual pieces, so there is no clear output effect.
card.plain: It lights up in dosing directions at the spot just before a number or interval comes next.
